edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial minted supply in the constructor.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve, granting allowance authority.
msg.sender's balance is the source of funds debited in transfer.
msg.sender's allowance is spent in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter drives the balance arithmetic in transfer.
to parameter determines which balance entry is incremented in transfer.
from parameter determines which balance is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter determines which balance is credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance and allowance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction against balances[address(0)].
